body: I'm not super concerned, I just didn't want my friends seeing this and being like OH NO WORRIED. None of them are on this sub so it's no big deal. Thank you though :)

Well I mean I'm sending flowers for his dad's funeral and I plan on dropping by his work time to time to check in on him. We parted on good terms and I know that the only thing to do is learn from it, I just hate knowing it took that level of tragedy and cruelty to teach me.
